articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Enhanced Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a vastly expanded context window reaching 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates near-expert-level performance on graduate-level science and mathematics benchmarks, raising the bar for frontier AI capabilities.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Achieves State-of-the-Art on Agentic Coding Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind's latest Gemini 2.5 Ultra model set new records on SWE-Bench Verified and other agentic software engineering benchmarks, autonomously resolving over 70% of real-world GitHub issues. The model integrates deep planning with tool use, signaling a shift toward AI systems that can independently manage complex codebases.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Breakthrough Interpretability Research Mapping Claude's Internal Reasoning
articles.summary: Anthropic released a landmark paper demonstrating comprehensive circuit-level tracing of how large language models form and execute multi-step reasoning plans internally. The research enables targeted identification of deceptive or unfaithful reasoning patterns, offering the most granular view yet of LLM cognition and meaningfully advancing AI safety evaluation methodology.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Manufacturing Facilities
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has entered limited real-world deployment at two of its own manufacturing plants, performing parts sorting, material transport, and basic assembly tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for task understanding.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment Across European Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Figure AI announced an expanded partnership with BMW to deploy its Figure 02 humanoid robots across three additional European assembly plants, scaling from pilot programs to production-integrated workflows. The robots handle ergonomically challenging insertion and inspection tasks, with BMW reporting a 15% throughput improvement in deployed zones.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production on A14 2nm Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production on its N2 (2nm) process using gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors, delivering an estimated 25% performance improvement and 30% power reduction over the 3nm N3E node. Initial customers include Apple and NVIDIA, with chips expected in consumer and datacenter products by early 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Expanded Brain-Computer Interface Trial in Paralysis Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink clearance to expand its PRIME clinical trial to 50 additional participants with spinal cord injuries and ALS, following positive 18-month outcomes from initial implant recipients. Participants have demonstrated reliable cursor control and text communication at speeds exceeding 40 words per minute using thought alone.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 Maverick Model, Rivaling Closed-Source Competitors
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Maverick, a mixture-of-experts open-weight model with 400B total parameters and 17 active experts per forward pass, achieving performance competitive with GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 on major benchmarks. The release includes optimized inference code for single-node deployment, further democratizing access to frontier-class model capabilities.
